shared_elements: circular or ring-like element (disc / eye-like round form)
paired symmetrical shapes suggestive of eyes or a face
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, outlined curvilinear motifs including rounded eye- or disc-like forms and paired symmetrical elements that hint at a face, and both render these schematically as raised ridges without interior detailing. But A is unambiguously a complete anthropomorphic figure with head, torso, banded belt-like registers and a centred ring on the back, while B is a loose spread of scrolling forms with no discernible whole-body figure or ordered registers, so the correspondence stays at the level of generic curvilinear relief.
